coordinate_system: AABB in rigid floor-aligned frame; oriented box in original prepared world

floor_fit.note: Rigid orientation from 14 previously photo-qualified floor witnesses; local floor coverings may warp. No camera intrinsics/extrinsics recalibrated.

reason: Grey actor lands on thick mat at 1.5s and remains there at 2s
temporal_scope: Five sampled poses plus explicit margin; unsampled-time containment is not mathematically certified
remaining_uncertainty: Grey actor final-pose hull retains an occlusion shadow behind the body; xmin remains conservative. Do not label this box optimal or use hull rejection as occupancy free-space evidence.

margin_guarantee.semantics: Absolute face minimums: max(common,XYZ); lowerZ additionally max(bottom). No relation to optical mask padding.

limitations: Integral bounding footprints can retain false volume, especially at coarse resolution.
Unobserved/occluded/out-of-FOV volume is UNKNOWN, never certified empty; only observed multi-view actor support contributes to this bounding hypothesis.
Padding/contradiction allowance protect some mask false negatives, not an exact hair matte.
Ray-box coverage is necessary but does not prove actor surface depth or hidden geometry.

component_qualification.discarded_semantics: unresolved remote silhouette components, NOT known free space
